reviewer: Codex multimodal visual inspection in this chat (not a separate human certification)
reviewMethod: Actual native-size image inspection plus actual 200px thumbnail sheet. Earlier defects corrected and changed bytes re-inspected. No automated assertion of artistic/factual quality.
